No Fool Pie
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 11:38pm

Ingredients




3/4 stick butter
1 cup self-rising flour
3/4 cup sugar
3/4 cup milk
1 - 1 ½ c. drained fruit (peaches, fruit cocktail<

Preparation

1 Melt butter in 8" or 9" baking dish. Combine flour, sugar and milk. Pour batter over melted butter. Place fruit on top. Bake 30 to 40 minutes at 350 degrees.
